name: Numa donation-manipulable vault price used as lending oracle
summary: NumaVault prices NUMA from its raw rETH balance over supply and NumaPriceOracleNew feeds that spot price to the Numa lending comptroller. In one flash-loaned tx the attacker borrowed NUMA against rETH, sold it into the vault, donated rETH to lift the NUMA debt price, self-liquidated 26 times to recover collateral and borrowed vault rETH against leftover cNUMA.
notes: Stateless immutable NumaPriceOracleNew returns vault.numaToLst / lstToNuma spot prices as the comptroller's collateral and borrow prices. NumaComptroller consumes it; its crETH collateral factor (0 to 0.95), which the NUMA borrows against crETH needed, was the last launch-wiring change (after oracle set, listings, cNUMA factor) and sets the age.
Immutable NumaVault runtime reads lstToken.balanceOf(this) in getVaultBalance, so an unaccounted rETH transfer reprices NUMA; it also hosts liquidateNumaBorrower used for the self-liquidations.

NumaVault rETH depletion across the exploit transaction and the attacker's same-session vault sale (source-2), net of attacker-supplied rETH that stayed in the vault (150 rETH donation, 10 rETH buy) and excluding 3.890749723489182171 rETH of protocol fees paid to Numa's own fee/reward Safe. Recipients: attacker 292.969043721660915071 rETH (matches the project's reported 292.96 rETH), Aave rETH flash-loan premium 1.116841928270578525 rETH. cNUMA lenders' 3,626,482.92 NUMA (bad debt) were burned into the vault for this rETH and are not counted again. Later team/partner recapitalisation does not reduce gross loss.

Price-source half of one failure: deployed 6837 blocks before NumaPriceOracleNew. VaultManager 0x2b8ceb24761d585bd5bc03172253d8f570e76c47 (aggregates vault.getEthBalance into the price, deployed earlier) is not separately targeted.
